instruction: There's a party night poster image that I accidentally deleted. Please retrieve it from the recycle bin and put it back on my Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: [ -f /home/user/Desktop/poster_party_night.webp ] && echo 'File exists.' || echo 'File does not exist.'

metadata.explanation: Recovery task using 'recycle bin' terminology (synonym for Trash). Evaluator verifies successful restoration to Desktop.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies file restoration to Desktop location
Getter logic correctly executes shell command to check file existence at /home/user/Desktop/poster_party_night.webp
Metric logic correctly uses exact_match to compare command output with expected value 'File exists.\n'
Expected value correctly includes newline character from echo command
Complete coverage: instruction requires file restoration to Desktop, evaluator verifies file exists at Desktop
No postconfig needed: file state is persistent after restoration
Data flow is correct: command executes -> output captured -> exact match comparison
